subject: I-O status
notes: §9.1.13.7 2) '42' for CLOSE or UNLOCK on a connector that is not open (cite.py --check OK §9.1.13.7 2)). CLOSE: FileConnector.Close `if (!IsOpen) return Status = FileNotOpen`, and FileRegistry.Close tests it first on both the CLOSE-UNIT arm and the close-file arm (§14.9.6.4 GR1). UNLOCK: FileRegistry.Unlock `if (!c.IsOpen) { c.SetStatus(FileStatusCode.FileNotOpen); return; }` (PB360 landed; goes through Require). Probe logic4x/p1.cob: CLOSE not open -> 42, UNLOCK not open -> 42.
